dialogues.speaker: Rerir
dialogues.text: Hah... You want to "go on living."

dialogues.speaker: Rerir
dialogues.text: I want to keep living, too... to keep living forever. That's why I have no choice but to continue on the path I'm on.

dialogues.speaker: Rerir
dialogues.text: If only some savior would suddenly swoop down and change the way the world is... Too bad that's not going to happen.
